metadata.title: Why an Atom and a Laser Quantize for the Same Reason (Worked Example)
metadata.thing: one boundary rule n*lambda/2 = L, applied twice: a laser cavity (mode spacing c/2L) and an electron in a box (E_n = n^2 h^2 / 8 m L^2), worked with real numbers
metadata.color_notes: Walls/axes/labels/numbers = ink #1a1a1a. Surviving standing waves + boxed shared rule = accent #5A5653. The two punchline answers (500 MHz spacing; 0.38/1.5 eV levels) = red #C0392B. Math is MathTex (LaTeX, MacTeX).
metadata.math_rendering: MathTex (LaTeX). Shared rule n*lambda/2 = L -> lambda_n = 2L/n. Laser: f_n = nc/2L; L=0.30 m -> df = c/2L = 2.998e8/0.60 = 4.997e8 Hz ~ 500 MHz; HeNe 632.8 nm -> n = 2L/lambda = 0.60/632.8e-9 ~ 9.5e5. Box: E_n = n^2 h^2/8mL^2; L=1 nm -> E1 = 6.03e-20 J = 0.376 eV ~ 0.38 eV, E2 = 4*E1 = 1.50 eV.

Bear's Notes

Why an Atom and a Laser Quantize for the Same Reason
beats.tts_normalized_text:
Bear's Notes.

Why an Atom and a Laser Quantize for the Same Reason.
beats.new_visual_element: title card: brand + two-walls-with-standing-wave motif + title

beats.narration_text: A laser shines in exact colours; an atom holds exact energies.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A laser shines in exact colours; an atom holds exact energies.

beats.narration_text: Both come from one rule — a wave has to fit between two walls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Both come from one rule — a wave has to fit between two walls.
beats.new_visual_element: narration card + two walls + fitted wave

beats.narration_text: Trap a wave between two walls and most wavelengths cancel themselves out.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Trap a wave between two walls and most wavelengths cancel themselves out.
beats.new_visual_element: two walls; a mismatched wave fading to flat

beats.narration_text: Only the ones that vanish at both walls survive — the standing waves.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Only the ones that vanish at both walls survive — the standing waves.
beats.new_visual_element: a fitted standing wave, zero at both walls

beats.narration_text: Fitting means a whole number of half-wavelengths spans the gap.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Fitting means a whole number of half-wavelengths spans the gap.
beats.new_visual_element: the shared rule, with a laser branch and an atom branch

beats.narration_text: n half-wavelengths equal the length L.
beats.tts_normalized_text: n half-wavelengths equal the length L.

beats.narration_text: For a laser cavity, that fixes the colours: frequency equals n c over two L.
beats.tts_normalized_text: For a laser cavity, that fixes the colours: frequency equals n c over two L.

beats.narration_text: For an electron in a box, it fixes the energies: E goes as n squared h squared over eight m L squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: For an electron in a box, it fixes the energies: E goes as n squared h squared over eight m L squared.

beats.new_visual_element: rule moves to top; two worked columns appear

beats.narration_text: A thirty-centimetre laser cavity spaces its modes by c over two L — about five hundred megahertz.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A thirty centimetre laser cavity spaces its modes by c over two L — about five hundred megahertz.
beats.new_visual_element: laser column: L = 0.30 m, mode spacing

beats.narration_text: Red light at six hundred thirty-three nanometres fits about nine hundred fifty thousand half-waves inside.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Red light at six hundred thirty three nanometres fits about nine hundred fifty thousand half waves inside.

beats.narration_text: Shrink the box to one nanometre and the same rule gives an electron levels of about zero point three eight and one point five electron-volts.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Shrink the box to one nanometre and the same rule gives an electron levels of about zero point three eight and one point five electron volts.

beats.narration_text: Widen the box or lengthen the cavity and the rungs crowd closer together.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Widen the box or lengthen the cavity and the rungs crowd closer together.
beats.new_visual_element: two ladders: small L wide gaps vs big L tight gaps

beats.narration_text: Same rule, two scales — modes you hear as colour, modes you measure as energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Same rule, two scales — modes you hear as colour, modes you measure as energy.

beats.narration_text: Only the waves that fit are allowed to exist.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Only the waves that fit are allowed to exist.
